title: A locked week, a finished Journey and the Library Continue card each say what is true

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19: "Do a super sweep 5000 of the site... Make sure everything is complete, fully evolved and validated." Found by the end to end sweep.

detail: Three leftovers from the Journey redesign (JRN-021 to JRN-026). The locked lesson panel still said 'This phase is still locked... so the whole Circle moves together', where every other surface says Week or Month and a solo learner has no Circle. The course home of a finished Journey with one optional step left read 'Journey finished' over the optional step's name. The Library's Continue card promised 'Your next month opens soon' on a yearly Journey whose every month is done. DONE 2026-11-19: the panel names the cadence and drops the Circle; finished wins in the headline and the line under it; the Continue card uses the grid card's sentence.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
